title: ASCII background
note: An ascii.rest scene behind the workspace. The palette follows the light and dark themes: dark keeps the scene's own near-black ground, light turns the same picture into paper.
placementNote: Choose what happens to the overflow, then which edge to keep. The picture always scales at the scene's own ratio, never stretched.
regionsNote: How much of the picture each region lets through. 0 is the host's own opaque surface, 1 is the skin's default.
scrimNote: Fades one edge of the picture towards the ground so the composer and the sidebar have a quiet base to sit on.
pauseOnBlurNote: Stop drawing while the window is in the background, and resume on return.
